summary: Session 2 of 3 for set 008 (x-offset field + collision semantics, backlog 6.2/6.5, E13-2/E13-5). Landed the procedure-model alist's optional (x-offset . N) field, staff-space units: cnb:resolve-config passes it through normalized (absent -> 0, present non-number warns and falls to 0; 3 new unit assertions, 288->291); the notehead acknowledger captures x-offset*staff-space into the new custom grob property cnb-x-offset (at acknowledge time, when the key-dependent config cache is current); cnb:apply-note-x-offsets - chained after cnb:compensate-stem-length on Stem.before-line-breaking - forces positioning-done to completion, then translates the NoteColumn by the COMMON component (least-displaced head's offset) and each head by its RESIDUAL. The 6.2 chord-mechanism decision was forced by measurement: BOTH candidates named in the Configurator 013 record s3.4 fail - (A) writing the mapped value into staff-position changes nothing for arrangement (it reads placed geometry; the record's 'diatonic-derived arrangement' diagnosis was mistaken - the real absorber is Stem::calc_positioning_done's extent-based edge-alignment + parity-reversal arithmetic, which keeps or cancels a stencil translation depending on stem direction and reversal order), and (B) the X-offset property is silently discarded for chord members (translate_axis materializes the offset cache before the property is evaluated) and single-note stems don't follow. Two further discovered failure modes: mutating grobs while positioning-done is being evaluated segfaults 2.24.2 multi-voice, and translating EVERY head of a stem segfaults from any phase (root-caused to stem.cc note_head_positions filter=true dropping heads at nonzero relative X + check_meshing_chords indexing the survivors unguarded; minimal repro: two voices, shared axis position, one offset single note). The landed column+residual split preserves the crash invariant (least-displaced head stays at relative X = 0). staff-position write from session 1 KEPT with corrected rationale: property/geometry consistency only. Acceptance measured vs byte-identical control (measure_xoffset_transcript.txt, exit 0): 19 single-note columns move head+stem +0.850 together with exact within-measure spacing accumulation (barline-elastic ~0.10 redistribution at measure boundaries documented as spacing, not offset loss); chord separation effects <c' cis'> +0.851, <gis' a'> +0.850 (the 013 absorbed case - THE acceptance), <f' fis'> +0.850, spanning <c' g'> 0.000; ledgers follow moved heads; verticals untouched. 6.5 verified and documented (measure_collisions_transcript.txt, exit 0): collision machinery reads placed geometry as ROUNDED positions, so cnb:collision-threshold compares axis-space distances (fractional-position maps quantize - handoff flag); axis-distance-0 equal-duration cross-voice pairs get column-aligned merge treatment with NO head wiped (both pitches render; x-offset is the separation, +0.850 measured) but stock merge wipes the down-stem head's DOTS (handoff flag); distances 1-2 use stock shift/touch heuristics in axis space with offsets composing additively (1.850 = 1.0 + 0.85); beyond threshold untouched; shared-pair chord over a second voice works (1.207 = 0.357 + 0.85). No redesign needed - no new backlog items; two handoff flags recorded. Zero drift with the field unset: unit 291/291, integration 246/246 (349 assertions), goldens byte-identical per git status, s1 spike-parity re-verified PASS on the final build. Honest-record notes in change-log: the mid-session WIP commit c2321d5 (session was suspended 2026-07-12 and completed 2026-07-13) shipped an interim mechanism whose multi-voice segfault was masked by a piped exit code and a stale SVG; all evidence re-produced with exit codes checked directly.
